aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio for all generations

look_prompt.description: Look sentence prepended to EVERY image prompt. Keep it positive-only — never use negations ('no text', 'no people'): generative models draw what is mentioned, so '노텍스트' literally draws text. State only what SHOULD be present.

id.description: Stable identifier used by state.json, filenames, and clips[].source_image

prompt.description: Per-image prompt. The look_prompt is prepended automatically.

anchor.description: Exactly ONE image must be the anchor. It is generated first, without a reference; every other image is generated with the anchor attached as a reference image so the whole set shares one look.

videos.description: ZERO-credit video generation via the 'Veo 3.1 - Lite [Lower Priority]' model. Verified Sep 2026: 720p (9:16), 4s/6s/8s, 0 credits. Defaults to x4 batch generation (4 variants per prompt for offline selection). Lower-priority = queued behind paid requests; expect 3-10+ minutes per clip with long stalls at fixed percentages.

prompt.description: Video prompt. For image-look continuity keep it close to the look_prompt sentence.

reference_image.description: Optional images[] id to attach as a reference (Ingredients) so the video matches that image's look.

source_image.description: ID of the image to animate. The source card is located by its Flow card TITLE (recorded in state.json), never by list position — Flow moves the selected card to the front, so positional picking spends credits on the wrong asset.

prompt.default: 첫 프레임 그대로 유지하고 아주 느린 카메라 이동
prompt.description: One slow camera move is enough. Rich prompts make the frame drift. Default: keep first frame, one very slow camera move.

properties_images_anchor.description: validation note: exactly one images[] item should carry anchor:true
